note: No signingKeyId. Control of the room's key is the entitlement to found its group; a request that omits it asks the recipient to decide whose room this is.
A member that is not a DID. The leaf identifies a party other members' key holders will see in every commit; a bare name identifies nobody.
A group secret offered by the caller. The group's secrets are created inside the recipient; a request that carried one would let the caller choose the key schedule every member then trusts.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
